opening_intro.text:
Joanne King is a licensed psychotherapist, mindfulness educator, and best-selling author with over 20 years of clinical experience in trauma-informed and integrative mental health care.
She specializes in Ketamine-Assisted Psychotherapy (KAP), mindfulness-based interventions, and somatic approaches that support deep emotional healing and sustainable transformation. Her work bridges evidence-informed practice with consciousness-oriented care, creating structured, ethical frameworks for preparation, journey support, and post-journey integration.
Joanne has developed practical integration tools—including guided reflective journaling, breathwork protocols, and embodied mindfulness practices—to enhance client safety, therapeutic depth, and long-term resilience. Her clinical model emphasizes nervous system regulation, relational repair, and meaning-making to help individuals move from symptom management to lasting growth.
She is deeply committed to advancing ethical, trauma-informed psychedelic care within clinical and organizational settings. Joanne seeks opportunities to collaborate with practitioners, research teams, and organizations focused on expanding responsible access to psychedelic-assisted therapies.
✨ Currently open to consulting, program development, clinical training, and leadership roles within the psychedelic and integrative mental health field.
